scene.label: Interactive 3D lesson network showing the collector SBD-SYSLOG01 writing daily archives to the audit repository SBD-AUDIT01 over encrypted SMB, the repository’s access events returning to the collector, and the audit custodian administering it from SBD-ADMIN-SRV01.
scene.completeCaption: SBD-AUDIT01 holds the collector’s record for its whole retention period: archives arrive by one encrypted path, their hashes are verified every day, access is audited off the box, and nothing leaves except by the custodian’s approved retention process.

nodes.name: SBD-AUDIT01
nodes.title: SBD-AUDIT01 · 10.0.50.40
nodes.description: The repository this course builds, on domain-joined Windows in its own Audit Servers OU. Its LogArchive share requires encryption and accepts one writer; archives are hashed on arrival and verified daily, and only SBD-Retention$ can delete.

nodes.name: SBD-SYSLOG01
nodes.title: SBD-SYSLOG01 · 10.0.20.20
nodes.description: The collector from course 1.3. Its daily archive task runs as SBD-Archive$, exports ForwardedEvents and zips the syslog files, hashes each archive, and writes it to SBD-AUDIT01. From lesson 3 it also receives the repository’s own access events.

nodes.name: SBD-DC01
nodes.title: SBD-DC01 · 10.0.10.10
nodes.description: Holds the forest’s one KDS root key, created in lesson 1 from a Tier 0 session, which lets the domain controllers manage the three group managed service accounts’ passwords. Its own events already reach the collector.

nodes.name: SBD-ADMIN-SRV01
nodes.title: SBD-ADMIN-SRV01 · 10.0.60.20
nodes.description: The audit custodian’s seat (rule A04). The custodian’s separate accounts open the only management sessions SBD-AUDIT01 accepts, from here; the same seat’s Tier 1 accounts manage the collector.

nodes.name: AdminJumpBox01
nodes.title: AdminJumpBox01 · 10.0.60.10
nodes.description: The Tier 0 seat (rule A01). The directory work happens here: the KDS root key, the gMSAs, the SBD Auditors group and its seat sign-in right, and the Audit Servers OU with its policy links.

flows.label: Tier 0 session · KDS key, gMSAs, OU

chapters.network: SBD-AUDIT01 is planned on VLAN 50 at 10.0.50.40. Directory work runs from AdminJumpBox01 to SBD-DC01, and the custodian’s first session comes from SBD-ADMIN-SRV01; no archive flows yet.

SBD-AUDIT01 on VLAN 50 is online. Once a day SBD-SYSLOG01 writes archives over SMB 3 with encryption (rule F11) as SBD-Archive$; nothing else reaches the share, and the custodian works from SBD-ADMIN-SRV01.

The archive path still runs from SBD-SYSLOG01 to SBD-AUDIT01, and the repository now sends its own access events and verification results back to the collector over event forwarding (F17), so the trail leaves the box.
Archives keep arriving from SBD-SYSLOG01. This lesson runs on SBD-AUDIT01 itself, in the custodian’s session from SBD-ADMIN-SRV01, and the retention task’s deletions reach the collector as events.

Every flow is shown: archives arrive from SBD-SYSLOG01 over F11, and the refused delete travels back to the collector as event 4656 over F17. The custodian runs the tests and the baseline from SBD-ADMIN-SRV01.
